risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (344.6), strong dollar pressures multinationals, CPI event in 1 day adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 22 days present binary risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, below Ichimoku cloud, negative CMF/AO, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, CPI event in 1 day, and earnings in 22 days create compounding risks that overwhelm weak technical momentum.
